## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (validate + build)
- [ ] English **and** Tamil files are both updated (for content changes)
- [ ] `sectionRefs`, Act names, dates and source URLs match across both languages
- [ ] Source URLs are official and use `https`
- [ ] Review statuses are honest (`reviewed` only with a named reviewer + date)
- [ ] New UI strings added to `src/i18n/ui.json` in **both** `en` and `ta`
- [ ] Checked on mobile width and with keyboard only
